description: Profile a Shopify store page to analyze Liquid template rendering performance. Returns FULL flame graph profiling data (same as Chrome extension). Requires OAuth2 authentication first (use the 'login' tool).

pagePath.description: The page path to profile (e.g., /products/example). Defaults to homepage '/'

storeUrl.description: The Shopify store URL (e.g., onebed.com.au or mystore.myshopify.com)

name: profile_page
